description: Permanently delete one uploaded file belonging to the current account, using its URL from list_uploaded_files or the gallery. Refuses files referenced by any post, including drafts, scheduled posts and published posts; never detaches media and has no force override. Deletes the storage object and its upload/library records.

url.description: URL of the file, exactly as returned by list_uploaded_files or the gallery.

name: delete_media_file
title: Delete uploaded media file
